courses.summary: SP Jain’s Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) is a 4-year full-time undergraduate program designed to craft graduates with well-developed business insights, critical thinking and decision-making skills. The BBA program curriculum is made up of general business, specialist business and liberal arts subjects. Students can choose to specialise in marketing, finance or AI for business. In addition to intensive academic learning, the program focuses on the development of key real-world business and employability skills, giving students the confidence, knowledge and expertise required to excel in a global setting. Students with honours may be eligible for up to 100% scholarship program.

courses.summary: In today's rapidly digitising world, data science has emerged as a game changer, driving groundbreaking decisions and innovations across industries. From uncovering emerging trends to solving complex challenges, data analytics is fundamentally transforming how organisations operate and strategise. As sectors from healthcare to finance increasingly rely on data-driven decision-making, the demand for skilled data scientists has grown dramatically. SP Jain Global’s Bachelor of Data Science is a rigorous three-year full-time program designed to prepare students for success in this dynamic field. The curriculum balances theoretical knowledge with practical application, ensuring graduates are well-equipped for the data-driven landscape. It provides: balanced focus on mathematical foundations and industry applications 70-80% of the curriculum dedicated to skill development and practical application covers a wide range of subjects including Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning, Big Data Processing, and Statistical Data Analysis
courses.careers: Graduates are prepared for roles in various industries including IT, consulting, BFSI, healthcare, education, retail, and media. Potential positions include data scientists, data analysts, data developers and data consultants.
courses.practicalExperience: Real-world projects in collaboration with industry leaders. Skill-building workshops on topics such as SAS JMP, AWS and Azure Cloud, DevOps, and MLOps. Opportunities for industry certifications. Multiple internship opportunities throughout the program (past internship partners: Amazon, KPMG, Uber, Macquarie Group, UPilot, Wolters Kluwer, Instagram, Adaptive Investments and more).

courses.name: Bachelor of Economics
courses.university: S P Jain School of Global Management
courses.area: Business communication, digital readiness in business, microeconomics, principles of management, world cultures, Foundation skills 1. Personal and career foundations, macroeconomics, sustainability and corporate social responsibility, marketing, introduction to AI in business, Regional Immersion Project 1 (RIP 1). 2. Ethics and moral reasoning, organizational behaviour, statistics, supply chain logistics and operations management, financial accounting, business disruptive technology. Employability and Practitioner skills Series 1: Emotional intelligence, corporate finance, decision science and analytics, research methodology, data science for business, Regional Immersion Project 2 (RIP2). Series 2: Leadership, teamwork, global dexterity, strategic human resources management, strategic cost accounting, foundations of entrepreneurship, client relationship management, AI driven digital marketing. Series 3: Communicating effectively, business law, decision making, advanced quantitative methods & modelling, sales channel management, project management. Series 4: Innovation, creativity and agility, strategic management, Australian business environment, advanced AI in business, branding and communications, cross-cultural marketing, retail management, Action Learning Project (ALP).

courses.summary: The Bachelor of Economics (BEC) at SP Jain Global is an accelerated 2.5-year (30 months) degree designed for students who want to fast-track their academic and career journey. The program offers an in-depth understanding of economics in a global context with a strong focus on quantitative and qualitative analysis, data-driven decision-making, and contemporary issues such as climate change economics. BEC graduates are equipped with the tools to think critically, analyse complex data, and provide solutions to real-world challenges. The program is suited for those considering careers as economists, in banking and financial services, or those planning postgraduate studies.
courses.careers: Graduates can pursue roles in economics, finance, research, and industry-specific sectors such as environment and climate change international organisations such as World Bank, International Monetary Fund (IMF), and United Nations. Potential roles include economist, policy analyst, financial analyst, consultant, research associate.
courses.practicalExperience: Students receive career readiness support through SP Jain Global’s Careers Services team, which provides coaching, resume building, interview practice, and networking opportunities. While placements are not guaranteed, our team works closely with students to help them connect with potential employers.
